title: Lemon chickpea bowl
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Put them in a bowl with the cucumber, tomatoes and parsley.
Mix the lemon juice and olive oil, then toss through the bowl. Taste and season before serving.

title: Apple cinnamon oats
steps: Put the oats, milk and diced apple in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and stir until the oats soften and the mixture reaches the texture you like. Add a splash of water if it becomes too thick.
Spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Tomato and lentil soup
steps: Warm the oil in a saucepan and soften the onion and carrot, stirring regularly.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and stock. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently until the lentils and carrot are tender, stirring and adding water as needed. Taste and season before serving.

title: Herby white bean toast
steps: Warm the oil in a pan. Add the garlic and stir briefly without letting it brown.
Add the drained beans and a splash of water. Heat until steaming, then roughly mash half the beans.
Toast the bread. Stir lemon juice and parsley into the beans and spoon over the toast.

title: Peanut sesame noodles
steps: Cook the noodles following their package instructions. Reserve a little cooking water before draining.
Stir the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil and lime juice together. Add a little warm cooking water to loosen.
Toss the noodles and carrot with the sauce. Serve while warm.

title: Roasted vegetable couscous
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the courgette and pepper in the olive oil on a roasting tray.
Roast until the vegetables are tender, turning during cooking.
Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over the hot stock and cover. When the stock is absorbed, fluff with a fork.
Fold in the roasted vegetables and lemon juice. Taste and season before serving.
